title: Ship Limatus Python SDK API for programmatic callers
description:
Public Python module API: load style config, diagnose draft text, propose options for human decisions, and render/apply helpers. Suitable for Papyrus and Tactus procedures. It uses the same core as the CLI, never a CLI wrapper.

Dependencies:
- blocked-by: LIM-dca47857-e14f-4c66-aa4a-37200a524880

Feature: Programmatic Limatus access
  Scenario: Diagnose without a subprocess
    Given a caller with draft text and local style configuration
    When it calls the public Limatus SDK
    Then it receives the same validated diagnosis shape as the CLI
    And no draft file is modified

Migrated from PPY-46c0b8.
